links.outcome: LLM/VLM performance on pediatric text and image questions, an underrepresented age group
links.effect: Dramatic performance drops in younger cohorts among evaluated open models; age bias described as reflecting pediatric underrepresentation in medical research.
links.quote: Evaluating state-of-the-art open models, we find dramatic performance drops in younger cohorts, highlighting the need for age-aware methods to ensure equitable AI support in pediatric care.

links.outcome: Model accuracy across pediatric developmental-stage subgroups
links.effect: Dramatic performance drops in younger cohorts across seven developmental stages (prenatal to adolescent).
links.quote: Evaluating state-of-the-art open models, we find dramatic performance drops in younger cohorts, highlighting the need for age-aware methods to ensure equitable AI support in pediatric care.

unlisted_practices: Building age-specific (pediatric) benchmarks to detect age bias in LLMs and VLMs

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks multimodal foundation models on a new pediatric QA dataset (PediatricsMQA) to assess performance across developmental stages and identify age bias, but it does not evaluate an implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
